Reassurance, follow-up and good dental hygiene.

With furosemide, captopril and high-calorie feeds.

Uncontrolled heart failure, failure to thrive and pulmonary hypertension.

Pulmonary stenosis, treated by balloon valvuloplasty.
What are the symptoms of aortic stenosis?
Chest pain, syncope on exercise and sudden death.
